# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** fifteen-year-old (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES P2](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0002)</sub>  
  _previously: eight (v3)_  <sub>[v3 ch.Farewell P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v3 ch.Farewell P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Dora is characterized by a neat and proper appearance, often wearing a nicely starched white dress accented with a black sash. She has gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and long, sleek curls that always remain neatly in place.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is a remarkably quiet, demure, and well-behaved young girl who comports herself as a model child. Known for her prim and proper demeanor, she remains composed, placid, and dispassionate even in unsettling situations. She is exceptionally neat, careful, faithful, and systematic in all her endeavors, never needing to be told how to perform a task twice. An industrious and helpful individual, her sensible and womanly nature makes her reliable, though her predictable manners can seem monotonous to others. Despite her steady composure, she harbors a distinct fear regarding [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's deceased uncle.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), +11 more_

## History

Dora Keith, along with her twin brother [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), was brought to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) after their mother passed away. Early in her stay, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) forced her to walk a pigpen fence and pumped water over her, ruining her dress. She was later locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse by her brother before being found by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md). Following the death of her uncle [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), a trust fund was left that allowed Dora and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to stay permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). As she grew older, Dora was comforted by [Anne](../character/anne.md) at school after being frightened by ghost stories. She later gave in to Davy's persuasion to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing, though [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) eventually confessed the trickery.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P1](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0001), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P6](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0006), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P8](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0008), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P9](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0009), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P10](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0010), +535 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--dora.md)

[Anne](../character/anne.md) helps care for and bring up Dora after persuading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to take in the orphaned twins upon their mother's death. [Anne](../character/anne.md) takes on responsibilities such as helping with sewing and guiding the children alongside [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Their relationship is that of a student and guardian, with [Anne](../character/anne.md) offering guidance and structure in the household.

- Student of — teacher helping to bring her up  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0030)</sub>

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) is Dora's twin brother, brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alongside her after the death of their mother. Their relationship is marked by Davy's mischievous antics at Dora's expense, such as ruining her dress by forcing her to walk a pigpen fence, pumping water over her, and locking her in a toolhouse.

- Sibling of — twin brother and sister  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P51](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0051), +8 more</sub>

### [Irving](../character/irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dora--irving.md)

[Irving](../character/irving.md) is a childhood acquaintance of Dora's who belongs to the broader circle of friends and family surrounding [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

- Friend of — childhood acquaintance  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P20](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0020)</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dora--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is a cousin of Dora's late mother who takes Dora and her twin brother into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to raise them. She manages the household and serves as a primary guardian, occasionally traveling into town with Dora.

- Comrade of — traveling companion to town  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001)</sub>
